snippet.title: Fantasy Network - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Fantasy Network on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492100/Fantasy_Network/

Fantasy Network launches for PC on August 6, 2026!

Welcome to the world’s first social media metroidvania. Explore the colorful lands of Holua, battle bizarre enemies with your trusty umbrella, meet eccentric characters and compete in Talent Competitions ranging from racing to retro arcade challenges.

Lyn’s mother has been kidnapped, and the ransom is anything but ordinary: she must win the President’s Race. Explore. Fight. Post. And uncover the truth hidden beneath Holua’s colorful surface.

Fantasy Network will be available on Steam, GOG, the Epic Games Store and other PC digital platforms.

Follow Fantasy Network:

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@fantasynetworkgame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fantasynetworkgame/
X: https://x.com/RavenTravelStd
Discord: https://discord.gg/kkdzRDWm7g

Developed by Raven Travel Studios
Published by IMGN.PRO
